coaching.headline: Fights won late turned into the base: after the teamfight won 4-2, structures went eight to one, ending on three inhibitors and the Core.

flags.text: Revenant ran the damn show: 49425 hero damage, most of all ten, and six kills on Eden.
Two Fangtooths, Mini Prime, Genesis Core, Primal Fangtooth and Orb Prime went allied; the enemy took one Fangtooth.
Crunch: 1243 hero damage per minute on a 728 norm, and the final kill before the Core.
Costly as hell: Eden killed Revenant twice and Argus once in the enemy half, then Fangtooth went enemy.

focus.title: Group for Fangtooth, keep cashing
focus.action: Before each Fangtooth, Revenant and Argus stop trading with Eden in the enemy half and reset to the pit with Khaimera and Gadget; turn every won fight into the nearest structure.

12.7.call: Won 3-1 at the Prime pit in the Mini Prime window; the next fight was lost 1-2 with Revenant and Khaimera killed, and Scarlett razed the allied offlane outer. Three enemies dead is a tower call.

15.4.call: Lost 0-2 at the Fangtooth pit: Countess killed Khaimera, Scarlett killed Gadget, and Fangtooth went enemy. Right after allied deaths elsewhere, ward the pit and let Fangtooth go.

19.9.call: Won 4-2: Revenant killed Eden right after Eden killed Khaimera and Gadget, Crunch scored three kills, and the enemy mid outer fell before Fangtooth went allied. That is the order to repeat.

d39e8be8-2090-4956-b138-cabea886aceb: Four deaths on the offlane before minute ten: Rampage's first blood, three to Scarlett, two outside any detected fight. Until minute ten, hug the outer tower whenever Rampage is unseen.
Took down the enemy offlane outer and inhibitor. Once that outer fell, kills on Countess and Zinx followed on mid and the duo lane; keep rotating that way.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: All three allied kills of the Mini Prime window at the Prime pit: Rampage, Scarlett, then Countess. With Mini Prime up, save the Dread Nova stun for the pit.
Only three deaths all game, and 11 wards, second among allies. Before each Fangtooth spawn, put one of those wards on the pit approach.
9586e93c-3354-48f0-8d8b-d154dba6fc14: Took the enemy duo inner and put up 20749 objective damage, second only to the jungler among all ten. After every won duo-lane fight, start the tower before enemy respawns.
Credited with a kill in five straight won fights, the last two on the enemy-half duo lane. While Eden is unseen, keep Gadget close before entering the enemy half.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: 18 assists, the most of any player, for 60% kill participation, plus 15 wards on an 8.4 norm. Hold that ward pace through every long game.
Razed the enemy duo outer and the mid inhibitor. Before each siege, place a ward past the tower to spot enemy defenders early.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Killed Eden and Rampage on the allied-half duo lane with kills down 3-9, yet no prize followed within ninety seconds. After the next duo-lane pick, take the duo outer.
27403 objective damage led all ten players, on 9.1 CS per minute against a 7.2 norm. Keep that clear pace and call each major timer to the team.

matchup: Scarlett was the lane opponent and scored three of five Crunch deaths, all before minute ten.
Rampage took first blood on the offlane, and Countess scored the only later death.
build: Augmentation and Salvation match the winning core; Mutilator, the third piece, was skipped.
Tainted Blade cuts healing on targets hit with physical damage, a direct answer to Rampage's 24889 healing and Zinx's heals.
Draconum, finished last, was not online in earlier fights.
eternal: Vesh turns a share of ability damage on heroes into damage over time; Lich adds magical lifesteal by level.
Nihil and Knell lead a toss-up in the Crunch offlane field; Vesh ranks behind both.
Lich with Phylactery, the pair run here, is the best Vesh pair.
augment: Combo Crunch grants stacking attack speed when Cross Crunch deals damage.
Combo Crunch leads a toss-up with Lunge Crunch in the Crunch offlane field. Sound keep.
crest: Gravitum's active fires an infinite-range projectile that grounds the first hero hit.
Gravitum leads a toss-up with Iceskorn Talons in the Crunch offlane field. Sound keep.
improvement: Mutilator over Draconum completes the winning core: max-health damage on hits plus omnivamp, giving up armor and the takedown heal.
Nihil for Vesh trades the damage-over-time major for stats that build through long fights; a toss-up lead, not a proven gain.

matchup: Countess was the lane opponent: two kills on Argus before minute ten, two deaths to Argus at the Prime pit later.
Countess's Feast leaps to a hero and suppresses; Synaptic Obliterator leaves Argus immobile, so cast the beams after Feast is spent.
build: Azure Core, Entropy and Wraith Leggings are the full winning core.
Tainted Scepter, finished last, cuts healing on magical damage hits: an answer to Countess's Blade Siphon heals.
eternal: Mind Rot makes the Vesh major also deal a share of the target's current health.
Satariel leans first in the Argus midlane field; Vesh ranks well behind.
Lich with Mind Rot, the pair run here, is the best Vesh pair.
augment: Arcane Engine grants stacking movement speed on ability damage to heroes.
Infinite Obliteration, Arcane Engine and Mana Catalyst are a three-way toss-up in the Argus midlane field. Sound keep.
crest: Soulbearer's active grants a shield, magical lifesteal and movement speed.
Soulbearer is the clear Best in the Argus midlane field. Sound keep.
improvement: No item change proven: the full winning core was built.
Satariel for Vesh is the field lean: power stacking on takedowns, at the cost of max health, with stacks lost on death.

matchup: Duo was Revenant and Gadget against Eden and Zinx; allied duo deaths before minute ten ran three to two.
Eden's Zero Shift swaps between ranged and melee stances; the melee stance heals from damage dealt to heroes.
Eden's 46476 hero damage was second in the game, behind only Revenant.
build: Vanquisher, Terminus and Imperator are the full winning core.
Vanquisher executes heroes taken below a small health threshold.
Equinox, the last item, shields below 40% health; the early deaths to Eden came before that shield.
eternal: Marrow heals from hero damage, more at low health; Roses adds takedown gold and a stronger major after hero kills.
Lotus is the clear Best in the Revenant carry field; Marrow ranks behind, though Blood Bank with Roses is Marrow's best pair.
augment: Quickdraw speeds reloads and raises jump height.
Quickdraw leans first in the Revenant carry field, ahead of Spectral Bounty. Sound keep.
crest: Pacifier's active dashes and empowers the next physical hit, much stronger on low-health targets, with a recast on hero kills.
Liberator is the clear Best in the Revenant carry field; Pacifier, the most played, ranks behind.
improvement: Liberator over Pacifier is the field-backed swap: a cleanse and shield, giving up the dash and the low-health burst.
Lotus for Marrow is the field's clear pick: random stat gains over time and on takedowns, giving up Marrow's healing from damage.

matchup: Zinx was the support opponent: 15 wards each, and 11521 healing for Zinx against 7409 for Gadget.
Allied wards edged the enemy 39 to 38 across the whole game.
build: Tainted Scepter is the one winning-core piece built; Timewarp and Megacosm were skipped.
Soulbinder adds bonus damage to long-range ability hits and permanently grows magical power, on a cooldown.
Caustica, the last item, ignores 35% of magical armor; the fights before Caustica ran without that penetration.
eternal: Vesh adds damage over time to ability hits on heroes; The Tenth Seal adds ultimate damage and haste at level ten.
Aion leans first in the Gadget support field; Vesh ranks lower; The Tenth Seal with Mind Rot is the best Vesh pair.
augment: Auto-Lock Amp speeds up the homing of Seek and Destroy.
Auto-Lock Amp is the clear Best in the Gadget support field. Sound keep.
crest: Tranquility's active heals Gadget and nearby heroes with brief damage mitigation; the passive raises the ward cap.
Leafsong and Tranquility lead a toss-up in the Gadget support field. Sound keep.
improvement: Timewarp for Soulbinder rejoins the winning core: non-ultimate cooldowns shrink steadily, giving up the long-range damage bonus.
Aion for Vesh is the field lean: mana regeneration and gold from spell damage, giving up the damage over time.

matchup: Rampage was the jungle opponent: one kill each way, with Rampage's coming in the allied jungle.
Countess scored two of four Khaimera deaths, at the Prime pit and the Fangtooth pit; Feast suppresses.
build: Overlord and Draconum are two of the winning core; Sky Splitter took the Rapture slot.
Sky Splitter's basic attacks deal a share of the target's current health, strongest against full-health targets.
Void Helm, finished last, raises all healing received and adds magical armor; earlier fights ran without Void Helm.
eternal: Lotus grants random stats over time and on takedowns; Early Bloom adds a level at twelve, Immaculate damage reduction near full health.
Lotus leans first in the Khaimera jungle field; Masterpiece with Prima Donna tops Early Bloom with Immaculate.
augment: Jungle Invasion adds physical power in any jungle, doubled in the enemy jungle.
Jungle Invasion is the clear Best in the Khaimera jungle field. Sound keep.
crest: Judgement's active deals area damage and heals on hero hits, with later hero hits healing at reduced effect.
Eviscerator is the clear Best in the Khaimera jungle field; Judgement ranks well behind.
improvement: Eviscerator over Judgement is the field-backed swap: attack speed, omnivamp and empowered hits, giving up the area damage and heal.
Masterpiece with Prima Donna over Early Bloom with Immaculate: kill-stacked damage and speed, at the cost of taking more damage.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.8s of lockdown): Countess Feast (suppress 0.75s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Zinx. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 3 items of it.
Dive threat on our backline: Countess. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Crunch Right Crunch (knockup 1.25s), Gadget Security Gate (root 1s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Gadget) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Forward Crunch gap-close stun → Right Crunch knockup → empowered Left Crunch, sustain via Re-Crunch
ourKits.winCondition: all-in a squishy with the empowered combo and heal back through Re-Crunch
ourKits.passive: post-ability empowered basic that refunds cooldowns
ourKits.playWith: peel-stripping engage so he reaches the backline
ourKits.playAgainst: peel/CC him off — without resets he's stranded; anti-heal blunts Re-Crunch

ourKits.combo: Dread Nova stun → Ether Crystal push/lift → Particle Shredder channel → Synaptic Obliterator beams
ourKits.winCondition: poke from max range and zone with the crystal
ourKits.playWith: a frontline to protect his stationary channel
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Dread Nova; dive him during the immobile ult channel

ourKits.combo: Scar mark → Obliterate homing missiles → Reckoning 1v1 realm ult
ourKits.winCondition: Reckoning a target into the Nether Realm and crit them down 1v1
ourKits.playWith: a team to clean up if his 1v1 stalls
ourKits.playAgainst: the ult is a 1v1 — peel the realmed ally can't help, so don't be caught alone; he's crit-reliant early-weak

ourKits.combo: Security Gate root → Sticky Mine → Tesla Dome zone ult
ourKits.winCondition: root with the gate and trap a fight inside the Tesla Dome
ourKits.passive: FDA stacks grant scaling magical power
ourKits.playWith: frontline that holds enemies in her Dome
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge the gate; spread vs the Dome — she's immobile, dive her

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
ourKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: stance-swap with Zero Shift → Tachyon Lance (ranged) or melee chain → Limit Break on Overheat
enemyKits.winCondition: build Heat and burst with Limit Break, flexing range and melee
enemyKits.passive: damage builds Heat → Overheat unlocks Limit Break
enemyKits.playWith: peel that lets her ramp Heat safely
enemyKits.playAgainst: pressure her before Overheat; CC during the melee stance

enemyKits.combo: Pounce → Rumble slow → Boulder Throw → Behemoth ult to brawl
enemyKits.winCondition: engage with Pounce, grow with Behemoth and out-sustain the fight
enemyKits.passive: ramping health regen for jungle sustain
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up damage while he front-lines and CCs
enemyKits.playAgainst: anti-heal and kiting beat his sustain brawl; burst him before Behemoth

enemyKits.combo: Shadow Slip in → Eventide → Blade Siphon → Feast suppress ult, Haemorrhage true-damage
enemyKits.winCondition: Feast-suppress a squishy and delete them with true-damage burst
enemyKits.passive: two-ability hits apply a %max-HP true-damage bleed
enemyKits.playWith: a team to clean up after her pick
enemyKits.playAgainst: Feast is her whole engage — bait it / peel; she's fragile, punish the recast window

enemyKits.combo: Ricochet stun → Bad Medicine zone → Infuse heal an ally → Neural Regenesis revive
enemyKits.winCondition: keep an ally alive with Infuse + the revive ult and poke with Ricochet
enemyKits.playWith: a carry she can pocket-heal and revive
enemyKits.playAgainst: she can't heal herself — dive HER; bait the revive before committing
